description: This file contains the implementation of the IpcClientControllerImpl class and related factory functions within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace. It manages IPC client controller state, including reset, failure status, error messages, and handling method call failures.

classes.name: ControllerFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IControllerFactory that creates ClientControllerImpl instances.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an IPC client controller managing RPC call states and failures.

methods.name: IControllerFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ControllerFactory instance.

methods.name: ControllerFactory::create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ClientControllerImpl instance.

methods.name: ClientControllerImpl::Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller's failure state and reason, preparing it for a new RPC call.

methods.name: ClientControllerImpl::Failed
methods.description: Returns whether the last RPC call failed.

methods.name: ClientControllerImpl::ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message if the last RPC call failed.

methods.name: ClientControllerImpl::setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state and reason when a method call fails, either from a string or formatted message.
